claim_definition: Verifies that an auditor can re-derive the gate decision from the ONLY Lang rules and the recorded inputs, producing the same receipt hash. This is the fixed-point property: the decision is a deterministic function of the rules and the inputs.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - receipt re-derivation test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
bind_context("data_hash_v1", "policy_hash_v1")
link_lineage("prior_receipt_hash_a3f5e8c1d2b4")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_authority("officer-42")
check_context_drift()
check_revocation()
require_continuous_lineage()
residual()

test_cases.description: An auditor must be able to re-derive the gate decision from the ONLY Lang rules and recorded inputs. The resulting receipt hash must match the original.
